# bbmp mgb replayer (I710x): Gameboy Tracker songs (.mgb) through bbmp's csrc/retro/gbt_engine.cpp (GPL-3.0-or-later, clean room), which builds a
# GBS image around the GBSoundSystem driver (MIT, mgb_driver.h generated by third_party/bbmp_mgb/regen.sh) and plays it with the existing
# selecta_gme (Game Music Emu), no second libgme copy. GPL, so its own loadable module under SELECTA_GPL_PLUGINS. Host only (exemption in row I710x).
enable_language(CXX)
set(BBMGB_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/bbmp_mgb")
set(SEL_MODULE_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/modules")
# gbt_engine.cpp includes <gme/gme.h>: third_party/ is the include root that has gme/gme.h.
sel_add_plugin(bbmp_mgb 1 MODULE adapter.c shim.cpp "${BBMGB_DIR}/gbt_engine.cpp"
  THIRD_PARTY_INCLUDES "${BBMGB_DIR}" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party")
set_source_files_properties("${BBMGB_DIR}/gbt_engine.cpp" shim.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
target_link_libraries(sel_module_bbmp_mgb PRIVATE selecta_gme ${CMAKE_CXX_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES})
set_target_properties(sel_module_bbmp_mgb PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17)
